ski_area: Portes du Soleil (Swiss side: Champéry–Les Crosets–Champoussin)
opening_source_note: Blick 26 Nov 2025 (Champéry–Les Crosets partial weekend opening); official PdS Suisse 2026/27 timetable
piste_km_basis: Full Portes du Soleil pass (only day pass sold); official +600 km, skiresort 580
score_notes: Swiss Wall (Chavanette) and Les Crosets/Mossettes off-piste with local guiding but no major event history; touring around the Dents du Midi is decent yet not a hub.
comments: Base = Champéry–Planachaux cable car (Les Crosets/Champoussin reachable by road, higher up). Swiss side sells only the full Portes du Soleil day pass in CHF: skiinfo CHF 72 vs bergfex CHF 81 high season 2025/26 (conflicting); official shop showed only season passes. Official 2026/27: Crosets 8 lift from 28 Nov 2026, Champéry–Planachaux from 5 Dec 2026, whole area 19 Dec 2026, close 11 Apr 2027. PdS official opening 2025/26 was 20 Dec 2025; skiresort top 2254 m is for whole PdS (Swiss top Pointe des Mossettes not verified). From Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel or Simplon; Pas de Morgins open in winter.

opening_source_note: Official PdS Suisse 2026/27 timetable (Morgins weekend 12–13 Dec 2026); 2025/26 Morgins-sector date not found
piste_km_basis: Full Portes du Soleil pass (only day pass sold); official +600 km, skiresort 580
score_notes: Mostly gentle on-piste terrain with some tree runs off La Foilleuse; limited local touring (Pointe de Bellevue, Corbeau).
comments: Morgins sector opens later than Les Crosets: official 2026/27 Morgins 12–13 Dec 2026 (whole PdS 19 Dec 2026, Morgins closes 4 Apr 2027). 2025/26: PdS official opening 20 Dec 2025 (Watson/Blick lists) but Morgins first lift day not found. Same full-PdS day pass as Champéry with conflicting aggregator prices (skiinfo 72 / bergfex 81). Base = La Foilleuse gondola. Pas de Morgins (to Châtel) open in winter; from Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel or Simplon.

opening_source_note: Official press release 29 Oct 2025 (Lac des Vaux 1 Nov); official 2026/27 prices page season dates
piste_km_basis: Verbier–La Tzoumaz–Bruson sector (Téléverbier, official); 4 Vallées 410 km
score_notes: FWT Xtreme Verbier finals venue (Bec des Rosses), Mont Fort/Mont Gelé/Vallon d'Arbi itineraries and 7 marked freeride routes; Haute Route Chamonix–Zermatt passes Verbier with Grand Combin/Rosablanche tours and a dense guide scene.
comments: Fixed prices 2026/27: Verbier–Tzoumaz 1-day CHF 86, 4 Vallées CHF 94, Bruson CHF 63; -10% online if bought 10+ days ahead. Official pass season Verbier–Tzoumaz 5 Dec 2026–25 Apr 2027 (4 Vallées 12 Dec 2026) but November weekend openings are usual: skiinfo lists 7 Nov 2026 and skiresort 14 Nov 2026 (provisional). Mont Fort glacier (3330 m) needs the 4 Vallées pass. Base = Médran gondola. From Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel (pass road closed in winter).

opening_source_note: Blick 26 Nov 2025 (partially open since 22 Nov); skiresort/skiinfo 2026/27 provisional 14 Nov 2026
score_notes: Nendaz Freeride FWQ venue (Mont Gond) plus Tortin/Gentianes/Mont Fort off-piste and 6 marked freetracks; documented day tours (Rosablanche, Cleuson/Prafleuri) and a Haute Route variant via Cabane de Prafleuri.
comments: Max 3330 m (Mont Fort, co-managed by NV Remontées Mécaniques and Téléverbier) requires the 4 Vallées pass (CHF 94 in 2026/27); Printse pass tops out lower (Greppon Blanc/Plan du Fou). Printse 1-day adult CHF 79 per skiinfo (2026/27); official shop uses online discounts (page data shows 'from CHF 62'). Base = Haute-Nendaz Tracouet gondola. From Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel or Simplon.

opening_source_note: Blick 26 Nov 2025 (Veysonnaz from 29 Nov); skiinfo Valais 2026/27 provisional list
score_notes: Shares 4 Vallées off-piste access (Mont Fort/Tortin via pass) but local terrain (Piste de l'Ours, Thyon side) is mostly on-piste; limited local touring.
comments: Lifts operated by NV Remontées Mécaniques (Nendaz–Veysonnaz). Printse pass CHF 79 (skiinfo 2026/27), 4 Vallées CHF 94. 3330 m (Mont Fort) only with the 4 Vallées pass; Veysonnaz's own lifts top out around Greppon Blanc (official value not found). skiresort lists 4 Vallées 2026/27 start 14 Nov 2026 (Verbier side). Base = Veysonnaz gondola. From Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel or Simplon.

opening_source_note: Blick 26 Nov 2025 (link to Thyon open from 29 Nov); skiinfo 2026/27 provisional 4 Dec 2026
score_notes: Marked but unsecured Eteygeon freeride itinerary from Greppon Blanc and Thyon–Dixence off-piste; touring mainly toward Val d'Hérens/Dixence with modest variety.
comments: Télé-Thyon SA operates Thyon 2000/Les Collons; Printse pass CHF 79 (skiinfo 2026/27). 3330 m (Mont Fort) only with the 4 Vallées pass; Thyon sector tops at Greppon Blanc (official value not found). Official thyon.ch is in summer mode; 2026/27 date from skiinfo provisional list. Base = Thyon 2000 (drive-to). From Italy via Simplon or Great St Bernard tunnel.

opening_source_note: Winter timetable start per Watson/Matterhorn Chalets lists (glacier year-round); official 2026/27 ski-pass page
piste_km_basis: Zermatt (Swiss-side) pass; official 'up to 200 km'; International 360 km
score_notes: World-class off-piste (Stockhorn/Rote Nase, Schwarztor, Klein Matterhorn glacier itineraries) with deep guide culture; Haute Route terminus and 4000er ski tours (Breithorn, Monte Rosa) make it a global touring hub.
comments: Year-round glacier skiing (365 days, Matterhorn glacier paradise). 2025/26 winter timetable from 1 Nov 2025 (Klein Matterhorn–Trockener Steg), other sectors 29 Nov and 6 Dec 2025; 2026/27 winter product 1 Nov 2026–3 May 2027. Dynamic pricing: official page shows only 'from CHF 89' (Zermatt) and 'from CHF 104' (International) for 2026/27; skiinfo lists Zermatt day pass CHF 96, skiresort CHF 116 (likely International peak). Car-free: park at Matterhorn Terminal Täsch (shuttle train). Official top 3883 m; skiresort 3899 m. From Italy via Simplon (car train Iselle–Brig as backup).

opening_source_note: Watson list 8 Nov 2025 (Saastal: 1 Nov Saas-Fee); official 2026/27 winter timetable (Alpin Express/Metro Alpin 31 Oct)
piste_km_basis: Saas-Fee area (skiresort); day pass also covers Saas-Almagell (+15 km)
score_notes: Glacier-based off-piste (Feechopf, Längfluh, Plattjen) with strong guide offices; classic 4000er ski tours (Allalinhorn, Alphubel, Strahlhorn, Britannia hut) give reliable high-alpine touring.
comments: Glacier summer/autumn skiing from 12 Jul 2025 (2025/26) and 18 Jul 2026 (skiresort 2026/27 season 18 Jul 2026–18 Apr 2027); official season statement 'Saas-Fee 1 Nov 2026–18 Apr 2027' while the timetable shows first winter lifts Sat 31 Oct 2026. Fixed 1-day adult CHF 84 (2026/27, Saas-Fee + Saas-Almagell). Car-free village: car journey ends at the Parkhaus at the village entrance. Official 'up to 3600 m'; skiresort 3573 m. From Italy via Simplon.

opening_source_note: Watson list 8 Nov 2025 (Saas-Grund 19 Dec); official saas-fee.ch 2026/27 timetable
score_notes: Big-vertical off-piste from Hohsaas (Trift/Triftalp) marketed as freeride terrain; classic 4000er tours (Weissmies, Lagginhorn, Fletschhorn) start from the lifts.
comments: Demand-based dynamic pricing (official); skiinfo lists 2026/27 day ticket CHF 59, skiresort CHF 62. Other aggregators give 20 Dec 2025 as the 2025/26 opening (one-day conflict with Watson's 19 Dec). Official 2026/27 season 19 Dec 2026–4 Apr 2027. Base = Hohsaas gondola valley station in Saas-Grund. From Italy via Simplon.

opening_source_note: Official MyCMA news (partial opening 29 Nov 2025); official winter opening-hours page 2026/27
score_notes: FWQ 2026 venue and Plaine Morte glacier/Faverges off-piste but not a renowned freeride destination; touring toward Wildstrubel/Plaine Morte with moderate variety.
comments: Dynamic pricing (early online booking discounts); bergfex high-season 2025/26 window price CHF 89. 2026/27: partial opening 28 Nov 2026 (snow permitting), full 19 Dec 2026–4 Apr 2027. Plaine Morte opened 3 Dec 2025. Elevation 2927 m from skiresort (official says 'up to 3000 m'). Base = Crans Cry d'Er gondola (Montana–Arnouva gondola is the alternative base). From Italy via Simplon.

opening_source_note: Blick 26 Nov 2025 (lifts open 29–30 Nov); official RMGZ horaires 2026/27 (weekends from 21 Nov)
score_notes: Renowned Valais freeride area (Grimentz Lona/Orzival and Zinal Sorebois faces) with FWQ history; Zinal is a touring hub (Bishorn via Cabane de Tracuit, Imperial Crown huts).
comments: 2026/27 official: Bendolla and Sorebois weekends from 21 Nov 2026, daily 18 Dec 2026–11 Apr 2027 (skiresort lists 28 Nov, skiinfo 5 Dec). skiinfo listed planned 2025/26 weekend openings from 15 Nov 2025; first verified operation 29–30 Nov 2025. Prices: skiresort CHF 73 (2025/26), skiinfo CHF 72 (2024/25); official tariff page is script-rendered. Base = Grimentz–Bendolla gondola. From Italy via Simplon.

opening_source_note: Blick 26 Nov 2025 ('should open Tsapé chair' 29–30 Nov); official horaires 2026/27 (daily from 18 Dec)
score_notes: Limited but quiet off-piste around Bella Tola/Illhorn; good local touring (Bella Tola, Meidpass, Turtmanntal access) with less variety.
comments: 2026/27 official: weekends from mid-November if snow allows, full season 18 Dec 2026–11 Apr 2027 (skiresort lists 28 Nov 2026). 2025/26 date based on a conditional press statement. Base coordinates approximate: Saint-Luc funicular valley station (Route du Funiculaire). Official 'up to 3000 m'; skiresort 2980 m. From Italy via Simplon.

opening_source_note: Walliser Zeitung 25 Nov 2025 (Fiescheralp lifts 29–30 Nov; official start 6 Dec); official season-times page 2026/27
score_notes: Eggishorn/Bettmerhorn off-piste routes above the Aletsch glacier; Fiescheralp is a classic start for Konkordiahütte/Aletsch glacier and Lötschenlücke tours.
comments: Car-free plateau: road head chosen = Fiesch valley station (Betten Talstation and Mörel are alternatives, slightly closer to Brig). Dynamic pricing 2026/27: 1-day pass CHF 53–84 EXCLUDING the valley cable car (Fiesch–Fiescheralp or Betten–Bettmeralp ticket extra). Official 2026/27 season 5 Dec 2026–3 Apr 2027. Elevation 2869 m from skiresort. From Italy via Simplon–Brig; Nufenen and Furka passes closed in winter.

opening_source_note: Blick overview 26 Nov 2025 (planned 13 Dec 2025); skiinfo.de 2026/27 (12 Dec 2026–29 Mar 2027)
score_notes: Family-oriented on-piste resort with limited off-piste; modest local touring (Seetalhorn, Wannihorn) in the Mattertal.
comments: Inclusion by altitude only (2864 m). 2025/26 date is the planned opening from a press list, not confirmed as actual. Prices from skiinfo (2026/27 day pass CHF 69); official shop is script-rendered; skiinfo Valais list also gives 12 Dec 2026. Base = Hannigalp gondola valley station. From Italy via Simplon–Visp–St. Niklaus.

opening_source_note: Blick/ulysse lists Nov 2025 (planned 13 Dec 2025); skiresort/bergfex 2026/27 season 12 Dec 2026
score_notes: Cult freeride spot (Hockenhorngrat 3111 m descents, freeride events, 1700 m vertical); Lötschental touring classics (Lötschenlücke/Hollandiahütte, Hockenhorn, Petersgrat).
comments: Car-free Lauchernalp reached by the Wiler–Lauchernalp cable car (road head Wiler). Dynamic ski-pass pricing (official tariff page); skiresort main-season CHF 70, bergfex n/a. 2025/26 date is the planned opening from press lists. From Italy via Simplon–Brig–Gampel–Lötschental.

opening_source_note: 2025/26 first day not found; skiresort and skiinfo 2026/27 season start 12 Dec 2026
score_notes: Hohstock (3118 m) and Sparrhorn off-piste with a local freeride reputation and long ungroomed runs; touring toward Oberaletschhütte/Aletsch glacier area.
comments: Car-free Belalp reached by cable car from Blatten bei Naters. Official belalp.ch shows no winter dates or prices yet (shop script-rendered); price CHF 74 = bergfex high season 2025/26. 2025/26 opening date not found in press lists (Blick overview did not list Belalp). From Italy via Simplon–Brig–Naters.

opening_source_note: bergfex season 2025/26 (22.11.25–19.04.26); official Evolène Région page 2026/27 (weekends from 21 Nov)
piste_km_basis: Arolla lifts (skiresort 26.7 km); Espace Dent-Blanche >100 km
score_notes: Few lifts but wild off-piste; Arolla is a classic Haute Route stage with Pigne d'Arolla, Mont Blanc de Cheilon and Vignettes/Dix hut tours and a long guide tradition.
comments: Small lift area: 2026/27 weekends and holidays from 21 Nov 2026, season to 18 Apr 2027 (skiresort same). Espace Dent-Blanche pass links Arolla/Evolène/La Forclaz (>100 km, 1400–3000 m). bergfex shows only the CHF 50 pre/late-season 2025/26 price (skiresort also 50). Base = Arolla village lifts (drive-to). From Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel or Simplon (Sion–Val d'Hérens).

score_notes: Mainly on-piste family terrain with limited off-piste (Chaux Ronde, Meilleret); modest touring (Chamossaire, Diablerets foothills).
comments: Dynamic pricing (TVGD: up to -50% online); skiresort main-season CHF 69; bergfex CHF 84 is likely the Alpes Vaudoises pass incl. Glacier 3000 (bergfex lists 1300–3000 m). 2025/26: five Bretaye pistes opened weekend 29–30 Nov 2025, full opening 5 Dec 2025. Col de la Croix (Villars–Les Diablerets road) closed in winter. Base = Villars Roc d'Orsay gondola. From Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel or Simplon.

opening_source_note: 24 Heures 23 Oct 2025 and Watson/Blick lists (8 Nov 2025); skiresort and official Magic Pass winter dates 2026/27
piste_km_basis: Glacier 3000 pass (skiresort 28 km); Les Diablerets village on Villars pass
score_notes: Glacier freeride itineraries (Combe d'Audon/Black Wall, Martisberg) and a dedicated ski-tourer gondola; touring to Les Diablerets summit, Oldenhorn and Sanetsch.
comments: Base = Col du Pillon cable car (drive-to; Col du Pillon kept open in winter). Glacier skiing typically early Nov to late Apr/May (skiresort 2026/27: 7 Nov 2026–30 Apr 2027; official ticketing lists Magic Pass winter 07.11.2026–30.04.2027). Les Diablerets village slopes (Meilleret) are on the Villars–Gryon–Les Diablerets pass (bergfex village season 5 Dec 2025). bergfex CHF 84 = Vaud Alps pass; skiresort Glacier 3000 CHF 79. From Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel or Simplon.

opening_source_note: 20 Minuten 25 Nov 2025 (partial opening Sat 29 Nov); skiresort 2026/27 season
score_notes: FWQ 2026 venue with Tour d'Aï/Chaux de Mont off-piste and a strong freestyle scene; touring limited to Tour d'Aï, Chaux de Mont and Pic Chaussy.
comments: Official teleleysin.ch unreachable during research (timeouts), so all key figures are from skiresort/press; webcam via Leysin roundshot (redirects to Tobogganing Park cam). Lift company Leysin–Les Mosses–La Lécherette (TLML). Base = Berneuse gondola (Leysin-Feydey). Col des Mosses open in winter. From Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel or Simplon.
